probeDesign.isolation: One ControlStore opened with filename ":memory:" (the worker explicitly supports it) plus one mkdtemp plugin rule file. No live dataDir, live control DB, Session, Task, Effect, model or embedding is touched.
probeDesign.scenario: Deterministic base clock (2026-01-01T00:00:00Z): (1) once rule at base+5000 -> baseline tick establishes history, tick at +4000 is not due, tick at +5000 accepts exactly one time.occurred, repeated tick creates no second event; (2) interval latest-only rule -> after 3.5 periods exactly one merged occurrence with canonical scheduledFor; (3) paused once rule -> due while paused produces nothing and resume does not revive the missed occurrence; (4) clock rollback -> visible CLOCK_ROLLBACK gap, no event; (5) once-wait subscription -> matching background event is claimed and matched through the trusted allowed gate, zero model; (6) receipt checks all entries and cleanup closes store + removes temp directory.
probeDesign.identity: Time event payload carries {subscriptionId, ruleRevision, occurrence, scheduledFor}; receipt.identity records subscriptionId, ruleRevision, occurrence (once:<revision>:<ISO>), scheduledFor, idempotencyKeyHash (sha256 of time:<sub>:<rev>:<occurrence>) and eventIdHash. Two probe runs with the same base yield identical identity hashes (event ids are random and only hashed).
probeDesign.receipt: Lossless JSON, <16 KiB offline: toolName/zeroModel/zeroEmbedding/zeroTaskOrEffect/store in-memory flag/catalog/clock steps/ticks/events summary+identity/onceWait/checks/released+disposed/diagnostics(close+temp cleanup+duration+catalog types).
probeDesign.noModel: The probe module imports only ControlStore, EventService, H2b rule/lifecycle/time-source modules, fs/os/path/crypto. There is no model, embedding, Task, Lab or Effect port in the dependency graph, and the receipt declares the zero guarantees explicitly.

hostProbeProtocol.admission: Same as session.probe: rejected while globally paused (ensureCanRun), consumes one shared runtime operation slot (capacity 2), abortable, no retry, no model/embedding/Task/Goal/Lab/Effect.
hostProbeProtocol.receiptChannel: Cached only read-only at snapshot().diagnostics.timeSourceProbe; the tool returns the same receipt. No business-event or delivery counts change.
expected: ok=true, zeroModel/zeroEmbedding/zeroTaskOrEffect=true, released=disposed=true, diagnostics cleanup all true
ticks: once-due accepted=1/eventsAfter=1, repeat-same-identity accepted=0/eventsAfter=1, latest-multi-period accepted=1, paused-due eventsAfter unchanged

checks: once_single_occurrence, repeat_tick_no_second_event, latest_only_single_merged_occurrence, paused_not_triggered_no_replay, clock_rollback_gap_no_trigger, once_wait_matched_zero_model, cleanup_complete all ok=true
GET /api/shiyu/state diagnostics.timeSourceProbe equals the tool receipt; task/Goal/Lab/event/delivery counts and runtime-state file unchanged except the diagnostic record location (no publication).
stop: Any failed receipt check, any non-zero model/embedding/task/effect observation, any business write, any cleanup failure, or a non-frozen reload => stop, preserve logs, do not retry.
hostProbeProtocol.limitation: The isolated probe proves the plugin-owned deterministic time-source semantics and cleanup offline. It does not prove that the live runtime TimeSourcePump fires schedules, that real host clocks/timezones behave as configured, or that real downstream notifications/effects occur. The live idle tick was separately observed; a real-model/real-host schedule firing remains G4.

gapsAndUntested: runtime.ts/index.ts integration (diagnostic command + shiyu_diagnose_time_source + diagnostics.timeSourceProbe) is delivered as a diff and not live.
Fixed-host invocation of the probe is NOT executed here; Lead runs it in the joint zero-model reload.

The probe uses the deterministic probe clock for the declarative time source while the control store subscription expiry/claim use the real wall clock; the once-wait deadline is therefore real-time based. This is intentional for isolation but is a probe-specific detail, not a product clock contract.

No real model/embedding/Task/Effect/channel/device was used. The probe does not prove the live runtime pump actually fires a due rule, nor real notification delivery, nor IANA DST handling (H2b uses injected offsets).
The in-memory control store exercises the real SQL event domain but no on-disk durability/restart of the probe store itself; H2b restart semantics are covered by the separate offline suite.
evidenceBoundaries: G1 offline: real in-memory SQLite through the ControlStore worker thread + real plugin rule file in a temp directory + synthetic deterministic clock. Not fixed-host or business acceptance.
